[17] 严格地说，阿根廷版的货币局制度有一点小的差别。基础货币的一个有限比例可以用以美元计值的阿根廷政府债务的形式持有。此项条款类似于 1914 年前的金本位制下中央银行被授权进行的国内信贷的“信用问题（fiduciary issue）”。

[18] 对这一理论的清楚表述和货币局制度的实践，见 Owen F. Humpage 和 Jean M. McIntire，“An Introduction to Currency Boards”，Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Economic Review 31 (Quarter 2, 1995)，pp. 2~11。也可见 Tomás J. T. Balio, Charles Fnoch 等人，Currency Board Arrangements: Issues and Experience, Occasional Paper 151 (Washington D.C.: International Monetary Fund, August 1997)。

[19] 见 Jagdish Bhagwati，“The Capital Myth,” Foreign Affairs 77 (May-June, 1998); Dani Rodrik, “Who Needs Capital—Account Convertibility?” in Stanley Fischler et al., Should the IMF Pursue Capital—Account Convertibility? Princeton Essays in International Finance 207 (May 1998)。

参考文献

Bela Balassa, “Adjustment Policies in Developing Countries: A Reassessment.” World Development 12 (September 1984), pp. 955~972. A review of trade and macroeconomic policies in developing countries after 1973.

Michael Bruno et al., eds, Lessons of Economic Stabilization and Its Aftermath. Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1991. A collection of case studies of stabilization programs in developing countries.

Guillermo A. Calvo, Leonardo Leiderman, and Carmen M. Reinhart, “Inflows of Capital to Developing Countries in the 1990s.” Journal of Economic Perspectives 10 (Spring 1996), pp. 123~139. Discusses the causes and effects of renewed lending to developing countries.

Paul Collier and Jan Willem Gunning, “Explaining African Economic Performance.” Journal of Economic Literature 37 (March 1999), pp. 69~111. Surveys the causes of Africa’s generally poor record of economic growth and stability.

Susan M. Collins, “Multiple Exchange Rates, Capital Controls, and Commercial Policy,” in Rudiger Dornhusch and F. Leslie C. H. Helmers, eds, The Open Economy: Tools for Policymakers in Developing Countries. New York: Oxford University Press (for the World Bank), 1988. Describes how developing country governments have regulated trade and capital flows to achieve policy goals.

Sebastian Edwards, Crisis and Reform in Latin America: From Despair to Hope. Oxford, U. K.: Oxford University Press, 1995. A comprehensive account of the background and progress of recent economic reform efforts in Latin America.
